dedupe_keys.name: nsta ukcs offshore infrastructure pipelines pipeline points and freespans subsea and surface installations ed50 etrs89 and wgs84

description: The North Sea Transition Authority publishes infrastructure data reported to it under section 34 of the Energy Act 2016, covering physical structures and facilities installed on the UK Continental Shelf under licences, field operations or pipeline works authorisations. The open data hub splits it into layers for pipeline lines, pipeline points, pipeline freespans, subsea lines and points and surface points, each in ED50, ETRS89 and WGS84 versions, with removed pipelines kept separately. The pipeline line layer, version of 1 July 2026, holds 9,025 features with NSTA pipeline number and name, fluid, pipeline system, status, diameter, internal diameter, wall thickness, length, insulation coating, maximum operating pressure, bundle, start and end dates, untrenched and exposed flags, and owner, operator and holder groups. Data are updated every six months (April and October) and are available as free downloads in Excel, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, shapefile and SQLite geodatabase formats and through ArcGIS feature services; the catalogue entry was modified on 13 August 2026. Coverage is the UK Continental Shelf. Caveats: shapefile downloads truncate long attributes, and no licence is shown in the item metadata read. Simulation uses are offshore oil and gas pipeline networks with physical attributes for flow, decommissioning and exposure studies. Related records: data-nsta-ukcs-carbon-storage-licences-sites comes from the same hub.
